question: What are the first 10 papers authored by the author with ID 3, including their abstracts, titles, and the IDs of the conferences where they were submitted?

query_1.description: Identify the first 10 papers authored by person ID 3.
query_1.cypher_query:
MATCH (p:Person)-[:AUTHORED]->(paper:Paper)
WHERE p.ID = 3
RETURN p.ID AS person_id, paper.ID AS paper_id
LIMIT 10

query_2.description: Retrieve the abstracts for the papers returned by query_1.
query_2.sql_query: SELECT ID AS abstract_id, has_text AS abstract_text FROM Abstract WHERE has_text IS NOT NULL AND is_the_1th_part_of IN (600, 0)

question: What are the member IDs, email addresses, and first and last names of the committee with ID 1000?

query_1.description: Identify all person IDs who are members of committee ID 1000.
query_1.cypher_query:
MATCH (p:Person)-[:MEMBER_OF]->(c:Committee)
WHERE c.ID = 1000
RETURN p.ID AS person_id
ORDER BY p.ID

query_2.description: Retrieve the email addresses for the members returned by query_1.
query_2.sql_query: SELECT Person AS person_id, VALUE AS email FROM has_an_email WHERE Person IN (56, 800, 998, 1396, 1800) ORDER BY Person

query_3.description: Retrieve the first and last names for the members returned by query_1.
query_3.sql_query: SELECT "ID" AS person_id, "has_the_first_name", "has_the_last_name" FROM "Person" WHERE "ID" IN (56, 800, 998, 1396, 1800) ORDER BY "ID"

query_3.description: Retrieve the paper titles and author information for the papers returned by query_1.
query_3.sql_query: SELECT p."ID" AS paper_id, p."has_a_paper_title", c."Person" AS author_id, per."has_the_first_name", per."has_the_last_name" FROM "Paper" p LEFT JOIN contributes c ON p."ID" = c."Conference_document" LEFT JOIN "Person" per ON c."Person" = per."ID" WHERE p."ID" IN (0, 9, 25, 50, 53, 63, 75, 77, 113, 119, 194, 226, 233, 265, 286, 288, 302, 322, 329, 333, 351, 362, 388, 423, 483, 485, 505, 532, 541, 543, 645, 716, 791, 826, 835, 873, 943, 1025, 1069, 1094, 1119, 1124, 1156, 1195, 1216, 1236, 1309, 1334, 1505, 1635, 1689, 1747, 1828, 1973) ORDER BY p."ID", c."Person"
